text: I'm really scared and I don't know if I'm overreacting. My son is 10. Earlier today he banged his head on the kitchen table, he cried straight away and then he was totally fine after, back to his usual self, so I wasn't worried about that bit at the time. But tonight something's not right. I went in to check on him and it took me ages to get him to wake up properly and when he did he just looked at me and didn't really answer, it's not like him at all, he's usually chatty even half asleep. He keeps drifting back off. And I've just realised he hasn't been for a wee since this morning, so that's over 12 hours, I asked him and he just mumbled. I haven't taken his temperature. Do I need to bring him in? I keep shaking him a bit to make sure he's still with me.
